newsitem.title: USA: Norwest Corp to buy Farmers National. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Norwest Corp to buy Farmers National. [CORRECTED]

text.p: Norwest Corp said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Farmers National Bancorp Inc of Geneseo, Ill. Terms were not disclosed.

Farmers National owns The Farmers National Bank with $181 million in assets and one locations each in Geneseo, Atkinson, Woodhull and Silvis, all in northwestern Illinois. (Corrects spelling of Silvis.)
The transaction, subject to approval by Farmers National shareholders and regulatory authorities, is expected to be completed in 1997.
Norwest is a $77.8 billion (corrects from million) banking and finance company.
